feeding_claim.verbatim: We raise 100% grass-fed beef, pastured chicken, pork and organic vegetables

notes: Read only the homepage of the farm's Local Food Marketplace store (seventh-generation farm in Rhodelia, Meade County; retail week-to-week online ordering, CSA signup and restaurant accounts; mentions CSA and farmers markets but names none). Product list, CSA signup and contact pages not read, so recheck products, pickup sites and market names there. Edible Kentucky CSA directory (not the farm's site) lists 2440 Popham Road, phone 859-608-6458 and CSA pickups in Louisville, Brandenburg, GE Appliance Park and Fort Knox; not added because not confirmed on the farm's own site. Verbatim quote may be the start of a longer sentence; recheck. Category grass-fed because the beef is called 100% grass-fed without saying how it is finished; chicken is pastured. USDA organic snapshot has 'Barr, Adam / Barr Farms', Rhodelia, certified for crops only (livestock blank), so run scripts/organic/match.mjs; the farm's organic claim is for vegetables.
